epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[chronos.getCurrentEpoch()];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation() external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return epochNodeMaxPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint256 epoch\n    ) external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[epoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return\n            (uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][epoch]) * 1e18) / epochPublishingAllocation[epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeCurrentEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n\n        if (epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch]);\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPublishingAllocationPercentage(uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1 || epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1] == 0) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return ((uint256(nodesEpochPublishingAllocation[identityId][currentEpoch - 1]) * 1e18) /\n            epochPublishingAllocation[currentEpoch - 1]);\n    }\n\n    function addTokensToEpochRange(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 startEpoch,\n        uint256 endEpoch,\n        uint96 tokenAmount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        // SECURITY FIX: a credit whose startEpoch is already FINALIZED is\n        // otherwise lost forever. `_finalizeEpochsUpTo` only folds `diff` for\n        // `(lastFinalizedEpoch, currentEpoch-1]` and never revisits a finalized\n        // epoch, so `diff[startEpoch] += p` at `startEpoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch`\n        // is never folded into `cumulative` (the tokens vanish \u2014 stranded in the\n        // contract with no payable pool entry) and the paired\n        // `diff[endEpoch+1] -= p` later under-credits an unrelated future epoch.\n        //\n        // Clamp the range up to `lastFinalizedEpoch + 1` \u2014 the first epoch NOT\n        // yet folded into `cumulative`, and therefore still payable (epochs above\n        // `lastFinalizedEpoch` are read via on-the-fly simulation in\n        // `getEpochPool`). This is the minimal correction: it rescues only the\n        // credits that were genuinely lost (finalized epochs) and lands them in\n        // the CLOSEST still-creditable epoch, preserving the caller's intended\n        // attribution as much as possible \u2014 PublishingConviction deliberately\n        // attributes a closed billing window to the chain epochs it overlapped,\n        // so forcing `currentEpoch` here would misattribute/delay those rewards\n        // on an idle shard. Any stricter \"settle into the current epoch\" policy\n        // belongs at the specific caller, not in this shared primitive. Clamp,\n        // don't revert: lazy past-window settlement is an intended pattern.\n        uint256 firstOpenEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        if (startEpoch < firstOpenEpoch) {\n            startEpoch = firstOpenEpoch;\n            if (endEpoch < startEpoch) {\n                endEpoch = startEpoch;\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint256 numEpochs = endEpoch - startEpoch + 1;\n\n        uint96 totalTokens = tokenAmount + accumulatedRemainder[shardId];\n        uint96 tokensPerEpochU = uint96(totalTokens / numEpochs);\n        uint96 remainder = uint96(totalTokens % numEpochs);\n\n        accumulatedRemainder[shardId] = remainder;\n\n        int96 tokensPerEpoch = int96(tokensPerEpochU);\n\n        diff[shardId][startEpoch] += tokensPerEpoch;\n        diff[shardId][endEpoch + 1] -= tokensPerEpoch;\n\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        emit TokensAddedToEpochRange(shardId, startEpoch, endEpoch, tokenAmount, remainder);\n    }\n\n    function payOutEpochTokens(\n        uint256 shardId,\n        uint256 epoch,\n        uint72 identityId,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch > 1) {\n            _finalizeEpochsUpTo(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n        }\n\n        distributed[shardId][epoch] += amount;\n        nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch] += amount;\n\n        emit EpochTokensPaidOut(shardId, epoch, identityId, amount);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) public view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch] - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        } else {\n            return _simulateEpochFinalization(shardId, epoch) - distributed[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getCurrentEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, chronos.getCurrentEpoch());\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochRemainingPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return getEpochRemainingPool(shardId, currentEpoch - 1);\n    }\n\n    function getEpochRangePool(uint256 shardId, uint256 startEpoch, uint256 endEpoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 lastFinalized = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId];\n        uint96 totalPool = 0;\n\n        if (startEpoch <= lastFinalized) {\n            for (uint256 epoch = startEpoch; epoch <= lastFinalized && epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n                totalPool += cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n            }\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = lastFinalized > 0 ? cumulative[shardId][lastFinalized] : cumulative[shardId][1];\n        for (uint256 epoch = lastFinalized + 1; epoch <= endEpoch; epoch++) {\n            int96 tmp = int96(simulatedCumulative) + diff[shardId][epoch];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(tmp);\n            if (epoch >= startEpoch) {\n                totalPool += simulatedCumulative;\n            }\n        }\n\n        return totalPool;\n    }\n\n    function getEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return distributed[shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getPreviousEpochDistributedPool(uint256 shardId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return distributed[shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function getNodeEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId, uint256 epoch) external view returns (uint96) {\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][epoch];\n    }\n\n    function getNodePreviousEpochPaidOut(uint256 shardId, uint72 identityId) external view returns (uint96) {\n        uint256 currentEpoch = chronos.getCurrentEpoch();\n        if (currentEpoch <= 1) {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        return nodesPaidOut[identityId][shardId][currentEpoch - 1];\n    }\n\n    function _finalizeEpochsUpTo(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal {\n        uint256 startEpoch = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1;\n        for (uint256 e = startEpoch; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = 0;\n            if (e > 1) {\n                prev = int96(cumulative[shardId][e - 1]);\n            }\n            cumulative[shardId][e] = uint96(prev + diff[shardId][e]);\n        }\n        lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] = epoch;\n\n        emit EpochsFinalized(shardId, startEpoch, epoch);\n    }\n\n    function _simulateEpochFinalization(uint256 shardId, uint256 epoch) internal view returns (uint96) {\n        if (epoch <= lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]) {\n            return cumulative[shardId][epoch];\n        }\n\n        uint96 simulatedCumulative = 0;\n        if (lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] > 0) {\n            simulatedCumulative = cumulative[shardId][lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId]];\n        }\n\n        for (uint256 e = lastFinalizedEpoch[shardId] + 1; e <= epoch; e++) {\n            int96 prev = int96(simulatedCumulative);\n            int96 result = prev + diff[shardId][e];\n            simulatedCumulative = uint96(result);\n        }\n\n        return simulatedCumulative;\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x74fd4c074d1dbe46453f8ffb5ed1cf3db3ca100604d631b46f5be40860bd0835","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/Hub.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {IContractStatus} from \"../interfaces/IContractStatus.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {HubLib} from \"../libraries/HubLib.sol\";\nimport {UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet} from \"../libraries/UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\n\ncontract Hub is INamed, IVersioned, Ownable {\n    using UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet for UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set;\n\n    event NewContract(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event NewAssetStorage(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageChanged(string contractName, address newContractAddress);\n    event ContractRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n    event AssetStorageRemoved(string contractName, address contractAddress);\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"Hub\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"1.0.0\";\n\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal contractSet;\n    UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Set internal assetStorageSet;\n\n    constructor() Ownable(msg.sender) {}\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setContractAddress(\n        string calldata contractName,\n        address newContractAddress\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContractAddress(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        _setAssetStorageAddress(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByName(string calldata contractName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            address contractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractName);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeContractByAddress(address contractAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractAddress)) {\n            string memory contractName = contractSet.get(contractAddress).name;\n\n            contractSet.remove(contractAddress);\n\n            emit ContractRemoved(contractName, contractAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByName(string calldata assetStorageName) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            address assetStorageAddress = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageName);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function removeAssetStorageByAddress(address assetStorageAddress) external onlyOwner {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress)) {\n            string memory assetStorageName = assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageAddress).name;\n\n            assetStorageSet.remove(assetStorageAddress);\n\n            emit AssetStorageRemoved(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function getContractAddress(string calldata contractName) external view returns (address) {\n        return contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (address) {\n        return assetStorageSet.get(assetStorageName).addr;\n    }\n\n    function getAllContracts() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return contractSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function getAllAssetStorages() external view returns (UnorderedNamedContractDynamicSet.Contract[] memory) {\n        return assetStorageSet.getAll();\n    }\n\n    function isContract(string calldata contractName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(contractName);\n    }\n\n    function isContract(address selectedContractAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return contractSet.exists(selectedContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(string calldata assetStorageName) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName);\n    }\n\n    function isAssetStorage(address assetStorageAddress) external view returns (bool) {\n        return assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageAddress);\n    }\n\n    /**\n     * @dev Forwards a function call to a specified target contract.\n     * @notice This function can only be called by the contract owner or a multisig owner.\n     * @param target The address of the target contract.\n     * @param data The calldata containing the function signature and arguments for the target contract's function.\n     * @return result The return data of the target contract's function call.\n     */\n    function forwardCall(address target, bytes calldata data) public onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner returns (bytes memory) {\n        // Check if the target contract is registered in the Hub\n        if (!contractSet.exists(target) && !assetStorageSet.exists(target)) {\n            revert HubLib.InvalidTargetContract(target);\n        }\n\n        // Perform the function call to the target contract with the specified calldata\n        (bool success, bytes memory result) = target.call{value: 0}(data);\n\n        // If the call is unsuccessful, revert the transaction with the original revert reason\n        if (!success) {\n            assembly {\n                // Load the free memory pointer from memory slot 0x40\n                // Memory slot 0x40 is conventionally used to store the free memory pointer in Solidity, which points\n                // to the next available memory slot for storing data during the execution of a contract function.\n                let ptr := mload(0x40)\n                // Get the size of the return data from the unsuccessful call\n                let size := returndatasize()\n                // Copy the return data to the memory location pointed to by ptr\n                returndatacopy(ptr, 0, size)\n                // Revert the transaction with the return data as the revert reason\n                revert(ptr, size)\n            }\n        }\n\n        return result;\n    }\n\n    function setAndReinitializeContracts(\n        HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts,\n        HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts,\n        address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize,\n        HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        _setContracts(newContracts);\n        _setAssetStorageContracts(newAssetStorageContracts);\n        _reinitializeContracts(contractsToReinitialize);\n        _forwardCalls(forwardCallsData);\n    }\n\n    function _setContractAddress(string calldata contractName, address newContractAddress) internal {\n        if (contractSet.exists(contractName)) {\n            contractSet.update(contractName, newContractAddress);\n\n            address oldContractAddress = contractSet.get(contractName).addr;\n            if (_isContract(oldContractAddress)) {\n                try IContractStatus(oldContractAddress).setStatus(false) {\n                    // success\n                } catch {\n                    // Best-effort: contract may not implement IContractStatus; ignore.\n                }\n            }\n\n            emit ContractChanged(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        } else {\n            contractSet.append(contractName, newContractAddress);\n\n            emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n        }\n\n        if (_isContract(newContractAddress)) {\n            try IContractStatus(newContractAddress).setStatus(true) {\n                // success\n            } catch {\n                // Best-effort: contract may not implement IContractStatus; ignore.\n            }\n        }\n\n        emit NewContract(contractName, newContractAddress);\n    }\n\n    function _setContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newContracts.length; ) {\n            _setContractAddress(newContracts[i].name, newContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageAddress(string calldata assetStorageName, address assetStorageAddress) internal {\n        if (assetStorageSet.exists(assetStorageName)) {\n            emit AssetStorageChanged(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.update(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        } else {\n            emit NewAssetStorage(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n            assetStorageSet.append(assetStorageName, assetStorageAddress);\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _setAssetStorageContracts(HubLib.Contract[] calldata newAssetStorageContracts) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < newAssetStorageContracts.length; ) {\n            _setAssetStorageAddress(newAssetStorageContracts[i].name, newAssetStorageContracts[i].addr);\n\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _reinitializeContracts(address[] calldata contractsToReinitialize) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < contractsToReinitialize.length; ) {\n            IInitializable(contractsToReinitialize[i]).initialize();\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _forwardCalls(HubLib.ForwardCallInputArgs[] calldata forwardCallsData) internal {\n        for (uint256 i; i < forwardCallsData.length; ) {\n            address contractAddress;\n\n            // Try to get the contract address using getContractAddress\n            try this.getContractAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                contractAddress = addr;\n            } catch {\n                // If getContractAddress fails, try getAssetStorageAddress\n                try this.getAssetStorageAddress(forwardCallsData[i].contractName) returns (address addr) {\n                    contractAddress = addr;\n                } catch {\n                    revert HubLib.ContractNotRegistered(forwardCallsData[i].contractName);\n                }\n            }\n            for (uint256 j; j < forwardCallsData[i].encodedData.length; ) {\n                forwardCall(contractAddress, forwardCallsData[i].encodedData[j]);\n                unchecked {\n                    j++;\n                }\n            }\n            unchecked {\n                i++;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    function _isContract(address addr) internal view returns (bool) {\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(addr)\n        }\n        return size > 0;\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert HubLib.UnauthorizedAccess(\"Only Hub Owner or Multisig Owner\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x732252bb857277a35ab314beef2dbaceb5f96ce2f6d3b83a224927e503609def","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ParametersStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ICustodian} from \"../interfaces/ICustodian.sol\";\n\ncontract ParametersStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    event ParameterChanged(string parameterName, uint256 parameterValue);\n    /// @notice Emitted when the protocol treasury recipient changes. The\n    ///         address is carried in its own event (rather than the\n    ///         `uint256`-valued `ParameterChanged`) so off-chain indexers get a\n    ///         typed `address` field.\n    event ProtocolTreasurySet(address indexed treasury);\n\n    error ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ParametersStorage\";\n    // protocol treasury fee (`protocolTreasuryFee`, `protocolTreasury`,\n    // `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE`) skimmed from the staker-bound TRAC on\n    // every paid publish / update / lifetime-extension.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.4\";\n\n    uint96 public minimumStake;\n    uint96 public maximumStake;\n\n    uint256 public stakeWithdrawalDelay;\n    uint256 public nodeAskUpdateDelay;\n    uint256 public operatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n    uint16 public opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation;\n    uint16 public shardingTableSizeLimit;\n\n    uint256 public minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n    uint256 public askUpperBoundFactor;\n    uint256 public askLowerBoundFactor;\n\n    uint16 public maxOperatorFee;\n\n    uint256 public v81ReleaseEpoch;\n    uint256 public publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n    /// @notice Protocol treasury fee in basis points (out of 10_000) skimmed\n    ///         from the staker-bound TRAC on every paid publish / update /\n    ///         lifetime-extension. The fee is taken out of the amount that\n    ///         would otherwise flow to the staker reward pool \u2014 it does NOT\n    ///         change the price a publisher pays. Default 300 (3%).\n    ///\n    ///         The fee is a no-op while `protocolTreasury == address(0)`\n    ///         (the full amount flows to stakers), so it stays dormant until\n    ///         governance wires a treasury recipient via `setProtocolTreasury`.\n    uint16 public protocolTreasuryFee;\n\n    /// @notice Recipient of the protocol treasury fee. The zero address\n    ///         disables the fee entirely regardless of `protocolTreasuryFee`.\n    address public protocolTreasury;\n\n    /// @notice Minimum TRAC deposit required to register a Context Graph\n    ///         on-chain (`ContextGraphs.createContextGraph`). The deposit is\n    ///         held as the CG's prepaid publishing escrow \u2014 spendable by the\n    ///         CG owner on publish/update/extend into that CG \u2014 and is never\n    ///         cash-refundable (residue sweeps to the staker reward pool on\n    ///         deactivation). Anti-spam for the unbounded-CG-creation DoS\n    ///         (OT-RFC-53). Setting it to 0 disables the deposit (dormant).\n    uint96 public contextGraphRegistrationDeposit;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `protocolTreasuryFee` (10%). Bounds\n    ///         governance so the fee can never be set to an extractive level\n    ///         that would starve the staker reward pool.\n    uint16 public constant MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE = 1_000;\n\n    /// @notice Hard upper bound on `publishingConvictionEpochs`.\n    ///\n    /// `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT._settleElapsed` / `_finalSweep` loop\n    /// `lockDurationEpochs` times in the worst case (dormant account\n    /// settled at expiry). Each iteration costs ~30\u201350k gas\n    /// (`windowSpent` SLOAD + one or two `epochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`\n    /// writes + a `WindowSettled` event), so an unbounded\n    /// `publishingConvictionEpochs` (the previous cap was `uint16.max`)\n    /// would let governance brick PCAs by setting the parameter past\n    /// the block-gas budget. 60 chain epochs \u2248 5 years at a 1-month\n    /// epoch length and worst-cases at ~3M gas \u2014 comfortably below\n    /// the block limit while leaving room for the surrounding\n    /// `publish` / `topUp` / NFT-transfer work.\n    uint256 public constant MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS = 60;\n\n    // @dev Only transactions by HubController owner or one of the owners of the MultiSig Wallet\n    modifier onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() {\n        _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner();\n        _;\n    }\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress, uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) HubDependent(hubAddress) {\n        minimumStake = 50_000 ether;\n        maximumStake = 10_000_000 ether;\n\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = 28 days;\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = 1 days;\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = 28 days;\n\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = 50;\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = 500;\n\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = 3;\n\n        askUpperBoundFactor = 1467000000000000000;\n        askLowerBoundFactor = 533000000000000000;\n\n        maxOperatorFee = 10_000;\n\n        // Epoch when v8.1 was released on mainnet/testnet\n        // Change if you ever redeploy delegatorsInfo contract on either network\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = 12;\n\n        // 3% default. Dormant until `protocolTreasury` is set (defaults to\n        // the zero address), so a fresh deploy behaves exactly as before\n        // until governance opts in.\n        protocolTreasuryFee = 300;\n\n        // OT-RFC-53: constructor leaves the registration deposit at 0; the\n        // standard deploy sets the live value (100 TRAC) via a post-deploy\n        // script that calls `setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit`. This protects\n        // production automatically (no manual step, no silent-off) while keeping\n        // test fixtures \u2014 which don't run that script \u2014 unaffected. Governance\n        // can retune or disable it anytime.\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function setAskUpperBoundFactor(uint256 _askUpperBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askUpperBoundFactor = _askUpperBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setAskLowerBoundFactor(uint256 _askLowerBoundFactor) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        askLowerBoundFactor = _askLowerBoundFactor;\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumRequiredSignatures(uint256 _minimumRequiredSignatures) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumRequiredSignatures = _minimumRequiredSignatures;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumRequiredSignatures\", _minimumRequiredSignatures);\n    }\n\n    function setMinimumStake(uint96 newMinimumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        minimumStake = newMinimumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"minimumStake\", newMinimumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setMaximumStake(uint96 newMaximumStake) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maximumStake = newMaximumStake;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maximumStake\", newMaximumStake);\n    }\n\n    function setStakeWithdrawalDelay(uint256 newStakeWithdrawalDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        stakeWithdrawalDelay = newStakeWithdrawalDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"stakeWithdrawalDelay\", newStakeWithdrawalDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setNodeAskUpdateDelay(uint256 newNodeAskUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        nodeAskUpdateDelay = newNodeAskUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"nodeAskUpdateDelay\", newNodeAskUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOperatorFeeUpdateDelay(uint256 newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        operatorFeeUpdateDelay = newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"operatorFeeUpdateDelay\", newOperatorFeeUpdateDelay);\n    }\n\n    function setOpWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation(\n        uint16 opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation = opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation\", opWalletsLimitOnProfileCreation);\n    }\n\n    function setShardingTableSizeLimit(uint16 shardingTableSizeLimit_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // Reject 0: ShardingTable._insertNode now enforces this cap\n        // (`nodesCount >= limit` reverts ShardingTableIsFull), so a 0 limit would\n        // freeze ALL node admission (even the first insert), bricking staking. 0\n        // is never a meaningful table size \u2014 reject it rather than let it act as\n        // an implicit pause switch.\n        if (shardingTableSizeLimit_ == 0) revert ZeroShardingTableSizeLimit();\n        shardingTableSizeLimit = shardingTableSizeLimit_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"shardingTableSizeLimit\", shardingTableSizeLimit);\n    }\n\n    function setMaxOperatorFee(uint16 maxOperatorFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        maxOperatorFee = maxOperatorFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"maxOperatorFee\", maxOperatorFee);\n    }\n\n    function setV81ReleaseEpoch(uint256 _v81ReleaseEpoch) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        v81ReleaseEpoch = _v81ReleaseEpoch;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"v81ReleaseEpoch\", _v81ReleaseEpoch);\n    }\n\n    function setPublishingConvictionEpochs(\n        uint256 _publishingConvictionEpochs\n    ) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        require(_publishingConvictionEpochs > 0, \"publishingConvictionEpochs must be > 0\");\n        // See `MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS` for the gas-budget\n        // rationale. The previous `<= type(uint16).max` bound permitted\n        // values that would gas-out PCA settlement.\n        require(\n            _publishingConvictionEpochs <= MAX_PUBLISHING_CONVICTION_EPOCHS,\n            \"publishingConvictionEpochs too large\"\n        );\n        publishingConvictionEpochs = _publishingConvictionEpochs;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"publishingConvictionEpochs\", _publishingConvictionEpochs);\n    }\n\n    function setContextGraphRegistrationDeposit(uint96 amount) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        contextGraphRegistrationDeposit = amount;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"contextGraphRegistrationDeposit\", amount);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasuryFee(uint16 protocolTreasuryFee_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        // See `MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE` for the rationale on the upper\n        // bound. 0 is allowed (disables the fee while keeping the recipient\n        // wired) \u2014 the floor is enforced implicitly by the unsigned type.\n        require(protocolTreasuryFee_ <= MAX_PROTOCOL_TREASURY_FEE, \"protocolTreasuryFee too large\");\n        protocolTreasuryFee = protocolTreasuryFee_;\n\n        emit ParameterChanged(\"protocolTreasuryFee\", protocolTreasuryFee_);\n    }\n\n    function setProtocolTreasury(address protocolTreasury_) external onlyOwnerOrMultiSigOwner {\n        protocolTreasury = protocolTreasury_;\n\n        emit ProtocolTreasurySet(protocolTreasury_);\n    }\n\n    function _isMultiSigOwner(address multiSigAddress) internal view returns (bool) {\n        // First check if the address has contract code\n        uint256 size;\n        assembly {\n            size := extcodesize(multiSigAddress)\n        }\n\n        // If no contract code, it's an EOA, not a multisig\n        if (size == 0) {\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        try ICustodian(multiSigAddress).getOwners() returns (address[] memory multiSigOwners) {\n            for (uint256 i = 0; i < multiSigOwners.length; i++) {\n                if (msg.sender == multiSigOwners[i]) {\n                    return true;\n                }\n            }\n        } catch {\n            // Not a multisig or call reverted; treat as not owner.\n        }\n\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    function _checkOwnerOrMultiSigOwner() internal view virtual {\n        address hubOwner = hub.owner();\n        if (msg.sender != hubOwner && msg.sender != address(hub) && !_isMultiSigOwner(hubOwner)) {\n            revert(\"Only Hub Owner, Hub, or Multisig Owner can call\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0xcfa8ee19dacc2be0de28973802d18037bfac66537db226afc21d259611c5bac2","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/PublishingConvictionStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0\n\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\n\nimport {INamed} from \"../interfaces/INamed.sol\";\nimport {IVersioned} from \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {IInitializable} from \"../interfaces/IInitializable.sol\";\nimport {HubDependent} from \"../abstract/HubDependent.sol\";\n\n/**\n * @title PublishingConvictionStorage\n * @notice Single source of truth for V10 publisher conviction account state.\n *\n * Architecture (mirrors the V10 staking split \u2014 `ConvictionStakingStorage`\n * holds positions, `StakingV10` is stateless logic, `DKGStakingConvictionNFT`\n * is a thin ERC-721 wrapper):\n *\n *   - `PublishingConvictionStorage` (this contract) owns every byte of\n *     application state for publisher conviction accounts: the `Account`\n *     struct keyed by `accountId`, per-billing-window TRAC accounting\n *     (`windowSpent`), the persistent top-up buffer (`topUpBalance`), the\n *     agent registration tables, and the governance-tunable\n *     `maxAgentsPerAccount` cap.\n *\n *     This is a fresh-state contract: it ships EMPTY at deploy time\n *     and there is NO automated migration path that copies state out\n *     of the legacy combined `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` v2.x. PCA\n *     accounts opened against the v2.x contract are NOT readable here\n *     after the upgrade. This is intentional and matches how the V10\n *     line has handled prior storage-split redeploys\n *     (`ProfileStorage`, `ParametersStorage`): network operators bump\n *     `chainResetMarker` in the network config so daemons auto-wipe\n *     their derived chain state on next start, the on-chain Hub\n *     re-points consumers (`KnowledgeAssetsV10`, `ContextGraphs`) at\n *     this contract, and the publisher fleet re-creates conviction\n *     accounts under the new wrapper. PR #650 ships the\n *     `chainResetMarker` bump alongside this storage contract; do\n *     NOT deploy the new PCA stack against a network without the\n *     accompanying marker bump. See `network/testnet.json` and the\n *     PR body's \"Migration / fresh-state reset\" section.\n *   - `PublishingConviction` (the new logic contract) holds zero\n *     application state \u2014 only Hub-resolved contract references and\n *     metadata. It reads/writes here via `onlyContracts`-gated mutators\n *     and runs every business rule (account creation, billing-window\n *     settlement, lazy passive-sink sweeps, post-expiry final sweep, and\n *     active-sink epoch distribution).\n *   - `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` keeps only the ERC-721 surface\n *     (mint/burn, transfer hook, ownership checks), the\n *     `_nextAccountId` mint counter, and the publisher-facing TRAC\n *     `transferFrom` paths. Every state read/write goes through this\n *     storage contract.\n *\n * Storage independence (the architectural goal):\n *   - The logic contract can be redeployed without touching account or\n *     agent state \u2014 Hub re-registers the new logic address, the storage\n *     keeps every existing `accounts[id]`, `topUpBalance[id]`,\n *     `windowSpent[id][w]`, and agent registration intact.\n *   - The NFT wrapper can also be redeployed (e.g. ERC-721 metadata\n *     surface change), at the cost of resetting `_nextAccountId` \u2014\n *     existing accounts keep their state but new mints would clash if\n *     the counter resets, so this is an upgrade path that requires care.\n *\n * State boundaries (what does NOT live here):\n *   - `_nextAccountId` \u2014 stays on the NFT wrapper because it is tightly\n *     coupled to ERC-721 mint ordering; the wrapper increments and\n *     supplies the new id to the logic contract on each `createAccount`\n *     forward (mirrors `DKGStakingConvictionNFT.nextTokenId`).\n *   - TRAC vault custody \u2014 TRAC sits in `ConvictionStakingStorage`\n *     (the V10 vault, post-v4.0.0 consolidation). This storage contract\n *     never holds TRAC and never moves it. The NFT wrapper drives\n *     `transferFrom(publisher \u2192 CSS)` directly on `createAccount` /\n *     `topUp`; this storage only updates the bookkeeping that controls\n *     how that escrowed TRAC eventually flows to staker pools via\n *     `EpochStorage.addTokensToEpochRange`.\n *\n * Caller gates:\n *   - Mutating functions are `onlyContracts` \u2014 only Hub-registered\n *     contracts (in practice `PublishingConviction`, with the NFT\n *     wrapper as a fallback for direct-write paths if ever needed) can\n *     invoke them.\n *   - `setMaxAgentsPerAccount` is `onlyHubOwner` because it is a\n *     governance-side parameter (mirrors `setStatus` / parameter\n *     setters on other V10 storage contracts).\n *\n * Invariants enforced inside this contract:\n *   - `agentToAccountId[agent] == accountId` iff\n *     `_isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] == true`. Agent register /\n *     deregister / clear-all paths flip both flags atomically so the\n *     two views never drift.\n *   - `_registeredAgents[accountId]` always equals the set of `agent`s\n *     for which `_isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] == true`. The\n *     swap-and-pop in `removeAgent` keeps the array in sync.\n */\ncontract PublishingConvictionStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent, IInitializable {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"PublishingConvictionStorage\";\n    // 1.0.0 \u2014 initial split-out from `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT` v2.0.0.\n    //         Identical state shape; no semantic changes.\n    // 10.0.3 \u2014 OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": `Account` gains\n    //          `primaryNode` + `lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch`, with the\n    //          `setPrimaryNodeData` onlyContracts setter.\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.3\";\n\n    /// @notice Default cap on registered agents per account, applied on\n    ///         first `initialize()` so a fresh deploy has a sane bound\n    ///         even before a HubOwner explicitly tunes it.\n    uint256 internal constant _DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT = 100;\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                     Account record\n    // ============================================================\n    //\n    // Field semantics (mirrors the legacy v2.x struct exactly so account\n    // state migrates 1:1 from the NFT):\n    //   - committedTRAC          : original commit at creation. Never\n    //                              changes after `createAccount`.\n    //   - createdAtEpoch         : Chronos epoch the account was created\n    //                              in (informational; not used for math).\n    //   - expiresAtEpoch         : first chain epoch past the account's\n    //                              lock (exclusive upper bound for\n    //                              `getRemainingAllowance`).\n    //   - createdAtTimestamp     : wall-clock anchor; billing windows\n    //                              are computed relative to this.\n    //   - expiresAtTimestamp     : `createdAtTimestamp +\n    //                              lockDurationEpochs * epochLength`.\n    //   - lockDurationEpochs     : number of billing windows the account\n    //                              spans (also the number of base-budget\n    //                              slices `committedTRAC` is divided into).\n    //   - discountBps            : 6-tier discount fixed at creation;\n    //                              top-ups do NOT change it.\n    //   - lastSettledWindow      : next unsettled billing-window index\n    //                              (exclusive of the highest already-swept\n    //                              window). Drives the lazy-settlement loop.\n    //   - fullySwept             : terminal flag. True once the post-expiry\n    //                              final sweep has accounted leftover\n    //                              top-up + dust to the staker pool. Acts\n    //                              as a re-entry guard.\n    struct Account {\n        uint96 committedTRAC;\n        uint40 createdAtEpoch;\n        uint40 expiresAtEpoch;\n        uint40 createdAtTimestamp;\n        uint40 expiresAtTimestamp;\n        uint16 lockDurationEpochs;\n        uint16 discountBps;\n        uint16 lastSettledWindow;\n        bool fullySwept;\n        // OT-RFC-51 \"Publishing Allocation\": the node this account's\n        // committed PCA budget is credited to as publishing allocation\n        // (K_n). `0` means no designated node (no allocation seeded).\n        uint72 primaryNode; // designated node identityId; 0 = none\n        // Rate-limit cursor for `setPrimaryNode`: re-designation is allowed\n        // at most once per chain epoch (require currentEpoch > this value).\n        uint40 lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch; // re-designation rate-limit cursor\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       Events\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Emitted when the governance-tunable agent cap changes.\n    event MaxAgentsPerAccountUpdated(uint256 oldCap, uint256 newCap);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                        Errors\n    // ============================================================\n\n    error AccountAlreadyExists(uint256 accountId);\n    error UnknownAccount(uint256 accountId);\n    error AgentAlreadyRegistered(address agent, uint256 existingAccountId);\n    error AgentNotRegistered(uint256 accountId, address agent);\n    error TopUpUnderflow(uint256 accountId, uint96 amount, uint96 balance);\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                       State\n    // ============================================================\n\n    mapping(uint256 => Account) public accounts;\n\n    /// @notice Per-billing-window TRAC drawn against the current\n    ///         account's base allowance. Second key is the billing-window\n    ///         index (0-based, relative to `Account.createdAtTimestamp`);\n    ///         it is NOT a chain-epoch number. The base allowance per\n    ///         window is `committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`; a window's\n    ///         entry is bounded by that value.\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint40 => uint96)) public windowSpent;\n\n    /// @notice Persistent top-up buffer per account (NOT per-window).\n    ///         Drained only when the current window's base allowance is\n    ///         exhausted. Any non-zero balance at account expiry is swept\n    ///         to the staker pool by the final-sweep path.\n    mapping(uint256 => uint96) public topUpBalance;\n\n    /// @notice Per-account agent enumeration. Kept as an array so the\n    ///         transfer hook on the NFT wrapper can iterate and clear\n    ///         every registration in one call. The agent-side reverse\n    ///         map is `agentToAccountId`.\n    mapping(uint256 => address[]) internal _registeredAgents;\n\n    /// @notice Reverse map exposed publicly so external callers\n    ///         (`KnowledgeAssetsV10`, `ContextGraphs`) can resolve a\n    ///         publishing-agent address to its paying account id without\n    ///         caller-supplied authorization. The \"not registered\"\n    ///         sentinel is `0`, which is why `_nextAccountId` on the NFT\n    ///         starts at 1.\n    mapping(address => uint256) public agentToAccountId;\n\n    /// @notice Membership index that lets `coverPublishingCost` /\n    ///         `deregisterAgent` decide whether an `agent` is registered\n    ///         under `accountId` in O(1) without scanning\n    ///         `_registeredAgents[accountId]`.\n    mapping(uint256 => mapping(address => bool)) internal _isRegisteredAgent;\n\n    /// @notice Governance-tunable cap on `_registeredAgents[accountId].length`.\n    ///         Initialized to `_DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT` on the\n    ///         first `initialize()`; a HubOwner can retune via\n    ///         `setMaxAgentsPerAccount`.\n    uint256 public maxAgentsPerAccount;\n\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    /// @dev `initialize()` is idempotent across redeploys: the first call\n    ///      seeds `maxAgentsPerAccount` to the default; subsequent calls\n    ///      (e.g. post-upgrade) preserve whatever value the HubOwner has\n    ///      tuned it to.\n    function initialize() external onlyHub {\n        if (maxAgentsPerAccount == 0) {\n            maxAgentsPerAccount = _DEFAULT_MAX_AGENTS_PER_ACCOUNT;\n        }\n    }\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Account read helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Return the full `Account` record by id. Reverts if the\n    ///         account has never been created (sentinel:\n    ///         `lockDurationEpochs == 0` because every real account\n    ///         carries at least one billing window).\n    function getAccount(uint256 accountId) external view returns (Account memory) {\n        Account memory a = accounts[accountId];\n        if (a.lockDurationEpochs == 0) revert UnknownAccount(accountId);\n        return a;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Existence check used by callers that only need to know\n    ///         whether an account record is populated (e.g. the public\n    ///         `settle()` short-circuit). Returns `false` for any\n    ///         accountId that has never been minted.\n    function accountExists(uint256 accountId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return accounts[accountId].lockDurationEpochs != 0;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Account write helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Persist a brand-new `Account` record. Used by\n    ///         `PublishingConviction.createAccount` after the NFT\n    ///         wrapper has allocated `accountId` from its mint counter.\n    ///         Reverts if a record at `accountId` already exists, so a\n    ///         logic-side bug or replay cannot silently overwrite an\n    ///         active account.\n    function createAccount(uint256 accountId, Account calldata acct) external onlyContracts {\n        if (accounts[accountId].lockDurationEpochs != 0) revert AccountAlreadyExists(accountId);\n        accounts[accountId] = acct;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Advance the lazy-settlement cursor. Caller (logic) is\n    ///         responsible for never moving it past `lockDurationEpochs`.\n    function setLastSettledWindow(uint256 accountId, uint16 w) external onlyContracts {\n        accounts[accountId].lastSettledWindow = w;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Mark the account as fully swept. Called once by the\n    ///         post-expiry final-sweep path; subsequent settle calls\n    ///         observe `fullySwept == true` and short-circuit.\n    function setFullySwept(uint256 accountId, bool v) external onlyContracts {\n        accounts[accountId].fullySwept = v;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice OT-RFC-51: persist the designated `primaryNode` and the\n    ///         `lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch` rate-limit cursor. Logic-side\n    ///         (`PublishingConviction.setPrimaryNode`) is responsible for\n    ///         the once-per-epoch gate and for `nodeExists` validation;\n    ///         storage just records.\n    function setPrimaryNodeData(\n        uint256 accountId,\n        uint72 node,\n        uint40 changeEpoch\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        accounts[accountId].primaryNode = node;\n        accounts[accountId].lastPrimaryNodeChangeEpoch = changeEpoch;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Window-spent write helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Add `amount` to `windowSpent[accountId][w]`. Logic-side\n    ///         callers are responsible for never exceeding the per-window\n    ///         base allowance (`committedTRAC / lockDurationEpochs`); the\n    ///         storage contract just records.\n    function increaseWindowSpent(\n        uint256 accountId,\n        uint40 w,\n        uint96 amount\n    ) external onlyContracts {\n        windowSpent[accountId][w] += amount;\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Top-up balance write helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Add to the persistent top-up buffer (publisher pays in\n    ///         to extend allowance beyond the base budget).\n    function increaseTopUpBalance(uint256 accountId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        topUpBalance[accountId] += amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Drain `amount` from the top-up buffer. Reverts on\n    ///         underflow so callers cannot silently overdraw \u2014 this is\n    ///         a defensive guard; logic-side `coverPublishingCost`\n    ///         already rejects insufficient-allowance combinations\n    ///         with a richer error.\n    function decreaseTopUpBalance(uint256 accountId, uint96 amount) external onlyContracts {\n        uint96 bal = topUpBalance[accountId];\n        if (amount > bal) revert TopUpUnderflow(accountId, amount, bal);\n        unchecked {\n            topUpBalance[accountId] = bal - amount;\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Zero the top-up buffer in a single SSTORE; used by the\n    ///         post-expiry final sweep before crediting the staker pool.\n    function clearTopUpBalance(uint256 accountId) external onlyContracts {\n        if (topUpBalance[accountId] != 0) {\n            topUpBalance[accountId] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Agent registry helpers\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Read the registered-agent array for an account. Returns\n    ///         an empty array for unknown accounts so callers can\n    ///         iterate safely on accounts that never registered an agent.\n    function getRegisteredAgents(uint256 accountId) external view returns (address[] memory) {\n        return _registeredAgents[accountId];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice O(1) membership check used by `coverPublishingCost` and\n    ///         `deregisterAgent` to validate (accountId, agent) pairs\n    ///         without scanning the array.\n    function isRegisteredAgent(uint256 accountId, address agent) external view returns (bool) {\n        return _isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent];\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Number of agents registered under `accountId`. Useful for\n    ///         the public `getAccountInfo` view on the NFT wrapper.\n    function agentCount(uint256 accountId) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return _registeredAgents[accountId].length;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Append `agent` under `accountId`. Reverts if `agent` is\n    ///         already registered anywhere (the reverse map is global \u2014\n    ///         a single agent address may pay for at most one account).\n    ///         The cap (`maxAgentsPerAccount`) is enforced by the logic\n    ///         contract, NOT here, because storage stays policy-free.\n    function addAgent(uint256 accountId, address agent) external onlyContracts {\n        if (agentToAccountId[agent] != 0) {\n            revert AgentAlreadyRegistered(agent, agentToAccountId[agent]);\n        }\n        _registeredAgents[accountId].push(agent);\n        _isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] = true;\n        agentToAccountId[agent] = accountId;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Remove `agent` from `accountId`. Reverts if not registered.\n    ///         The array is compacted via swap-and-pop; the reverse map\n    ///         and membership index are both cleared so the\n    ///         agent address can be re-registered later (against the\n    ///         same or a different account).\n    function removeAgent(uint256 accountId, address agent) external onlyContracts {\n        if (!_isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent]) {\n            revert AgentNotRegistered(accountId, agent);\n        }\n\n        _isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agent] = false;\n        agentToAccountId[agent] = 0;\n\n        address[] storage agents = _registeredAgents[accountId];\n        uint256 len = agents.length;\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            if (agents[i] == agent) {\n                agents[i] = agents[len - 1];\n                agents.pop();\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Bulk-clear every agent registration under `accountId`.\n    ///         Used by the NFT wrapper's transfer hook so the new owner\n    ///         starts with a clean agent slate (no inherited authorities\n    ///         from the prior owner). Idempotent on accounts with no\n    ///         registered agents.\n    function clearAgents(uint256 accountId) external onlyContracts {\n        address[] storage agents = _registeredAgents[accountId];\n        uint256 len = agents.length;\n        for (uint256 i; i < len; i++) {\n            _isRegisteredAgent[accountId][agents[i]] = false;\n            agentToAccountId[agents[i]] = 0;\n        }\n        if (len != 0) {\n            delete _registeredAgents[accountId];\n        }\n    }\n\n    // ============================================================\n    //                  Governance \u2014 agent cap\n    // ============================================================\n\n    /// @notice Tune the per-account agent cap. `onlyContracts` here so\n    ///         the NFT wrapper's `setMaxAgentsPerAccount` forwarder can\n    ///         drive the write \u2014 the wrapper enforces the `onlyHubOwner`\n    ///         user-facing gate. Direct PCS callers from outside the\n    ///         Hub-registered contract set are rejected. Setting the\n    ///         cap below an existing account's registered count does\n    ///         NOT retroactively unregister anyone \u2014 it only blocks\n    ///         further `addAgent` calls until the count drops.\n    function setMaxAgentsPerAccount(uint256 cap) external onlyContracts {\n        uint256 old = maxAgentsPerAccount;\n        maxAgentsPerAccount = cap;\n        emit MaxAgentsPerAccountUpdated(old, cap);\n    }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x2d6e6b42e0cb69f31b1e517cad8c3462e41288006cff4d281c85dd8d6426b3a0","license":"Apache-2.0"},"contracts/storage/ShardingTableStorage.sol":{"content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: \"../interfaces/IVersioned.sol\";\nimport {ShardingTableLib} from \"../libraries/ShardingTableLib.sol\";\n\ncontract ShardingTableStorage is INamed, IVersioned, HubDependent {\n    string private constant _NAME = \"ShardingTableStorage\";\n    string private constant _VERSION = \"10.0.2\";\n\n    event NodesCountIncremented(uint72 newCount);\n    event NodesCountDecremented(uint72 newCount);\n    event NodeObjectCreated(uint72 indexed identityId, bytes nodeId, uint256 hashRingPosition, uint72 index);\n    event NodeObjectDeleted(uint72 indexed identityId);\n    event NodeIndexIncremented(uint72 indexed identityId, uint72 newIndex);\n    event NodeIndexDecremented(uint72 indexed identityId, uint72 newIndex);\n    event IdentityIdIndexSet(uint72 indexed identityId, uint72 index);\n\n    uint72 public nodesCount;\n\n    // identityId => Node\n    mapping(uint72 => ShardingTableLib.Node) internal nodes;\n    // index => identityId\n    mapping(uint72 => uint72) public indexToIdentityId;\n\n    // solhint-disable-next-line no-empty-blocks\n    constructor(address hubAddress) HubDependent(hubAddress) {}\n\n    function name() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _NAME;\n    }\n\n    function version() external pure virtual override returns (string memory) {\n        return _VERSION;\n    }\n\n    function        nodeId: nodeId,\n            identityId: identityId\n        });\n\n        emit NodeObjectCreated(identityId, nodeId, hashRingPosition, index);\n    }\n\n    function getNode(uint72 identityId) external view returns (ShardingTableLib.Node memory) {\n        return nodes[identityId];\n    }\n\n    function deleteNodeObject(uint72 identityId) external onlyContracts {\n        delete nodes[identityId];\n\n        emit NodeObjectDeleted(identityId);\n    }\n\n    function nodeExists(uint72 identityId) external view returns (bool) {\n        return  nodes[indexToIdentityId[leftEdgeIndex]],\n            nodes[indexToIdentityId[closestNodeIndex]],\n            nodes[indexToIdentityId[rightEdgeIndex]]\n        );\n    }\n\n    function  return nodes[indexToIdentityId[index]].identityId != 0;\n    }\n\n    function getMultipleNodes(\n        uint72 firstIdentityId,\n        uint16 nodesNumber\n    ) external view returns }\n}\n","keccak256":"0x029cd19f31b1fd4656b53c9ab62e63549b6a52429385f7630c027a6395582c07","license":"Apache-2.0"}},"version":1}

ERC721InvalidOperator(address).details: Indicates a failure with the `operator` to be approved. Used in approvals.

ApprovalForAll(address,address,bool).details: Emitted when `owner` enables or disables (`approved`) `operator` to manage all of its assets.

Only a single account can be approved at a time, so approving the zero address clears previous approvals. Requirements: - The caller must own the token or be an approved operator. - `tokenId` must exist. Emits an {Approval} event.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the number of tokens in ``owner``'s account.

coverPublishingCost(address,uint96,uint4.details: The KAV10 gate lives here (not on the logic contract) so         the logic contract's caller gate can stay         `onlyConvictionNFT` and consistent with every other         NFT-driven entry point. KAV10 calls THIS contract; we         validate and forward.

createAccount(uint96,uint72).details: CEI ordering with `_mint` last:           1. Allocate `accountId` from the wrapper's mint counter.           2. Forward to `PublishingConviction.createAccount` which              persists the `Account` record on PCS and emits              `AccountCreated`. Logic-side parameter validation              runs here, BEFORE any funds move.           3. Pull TRAC from publisher to the V10 vault. The              wrapper holds NO TRAC — this is a direct              `transferFrom(publisher, ConvictionStakingStorage,              committedTRAC)`.           4. `_mint(msg.sender, accountId)` LAST. The wrapper              never observes a half-built (NFT-without-Account              -or-funding) state.         `_mint` (not `_safeMint`) is intentional: contract         publishers without `IERC721Receiver` (DAO treasuries,         relayer/factory wrappers, etc.) are part of the         supported caller set.         The forward-before-pull order means a logic-side revert         does not move funds. The whole tx reverts atomically on         any failure path — the NFT is never minted without TRAC         backing it and a recorded `Account` row.

isApprovedForAll(address,address).details: Returns if the `operator` is allowed to manage all of the assets of `owner`. See {setApprovalForAll}

ownerOf(uint256).details: Returns the owner of the `tokenId` token. Requirements: - `tokenId` must exist.

publishingConviction().details: Kept as a selector-stable getter, but intentionally does a         lazy Hub lookup so logic-only upgrades do not require         reinitializing this wrapper.

safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256.details: Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`, checking first that contract recipients are aware of the ERC-721 protocol to prevent tokens from being forever locked. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must have been allowed to move this token by either {approve} or   {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon   a safe transfer. Emits a {Transfer} event.

setApprovalForAll(address,bool).details: Approve or remove `operator` as an operator for the caller. Operators can call {transferFrom} or {safeTransferFrom} for any token owned by the caller. Requirements: - The `operator` cannot be the address zero. Emits an {ApprovalForAll} event.

setMaxAgentsPerAccount(uint256).details: Selector-stable forwarder for `setMaxAgentsPerAccount`.         The `onlyHubOwner` gate is enforced HERE because PCS's         own `setMaxAgentsPerAccount` is gated `onlyContracts`         (so this forwarder, a Hub-registered contract, may         drive the write). Without the gate on the wrapper, any         externally-owned account could re-tune the cap.

settle(uint256).details: Pure forwarder — the logic contract handles existence         and `fullySwept` short-circuit checks.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

tokenByIndex(uint256).details: Returns a token ID at a given `index` of all the tokens stored by the contract. Use along with {totalSupply} to enumerate all tokens.

tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address,uint256).details: Returns a token ID owned by `owner` at a given `index` of its token list. Use along with {balanceOf} to enumerate all of ``owner``'s tokens.

tokenURI(uint256).details: Returns the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) for `tokenId` token.

topUp(uint256,uint96).details: The wrapper owns ownership validation and the TRAC pull;         the logic contract enforces "amount > 0" and "not         expired", and triggers lazy settlement before crediting         the buffer. Order of operations matches `createAccount`:         logic update first, TRAC pull last so a logic-side         revert does not move funds.

totalSupply().details: Returns the total amount of tokens stored by the contract.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: Transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`. WARNING: Note that the caller is responsible to confirm that the recipient is capable of receiving ERC-721 or else they may be permanently lost. Usage of {safeTransferFrom} prevents loss, though the caller must understand this adds an external call which potentially creates a reentrancy vulnerability. Requirements: - `from` cannot be the zero address. - `to` cannot be the zero address. - `tokenId` token must be owned by `from`. - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}. Emits a {Transfer} event.

__reservedPublishingConviction.details: Reserved slot from the first v3 split draft where the logic      reference was cached. The public `publishingConviction()`      getter below now resolves Hub lazily.

Selector-compatible         with the legacy v2.x `accounts` public mapping AND         behavior-compatible with it: returns the all-zero         tuple for an unknown / unminted `accountId` instead         of reverting. Indexers and existence-probe callers         that read the legacy mapping continue to work         unchanged. Use `getAccount(accountId)` (forwarded         from `PublishingConvictionStorage`) for the         fail-closed variant that reverts `UnknownAccount`.         Implemented by forwarding to the storage contract's         auto-generated `accounts(accountId)` mapping getter,         not `getAccount(accountId)`, precisely so the unknown-         id branch keeps the legacy zero-tuple semantic. Codex         round 3 review on PR #650 flagged the prior         `getAccount(...)` forwarder as an observable behavior         break vs the legacy public mapping; this regression         is locked in by `accounts(unknown id) returns zero         tuple` in `DKGPublishingConvictionNFT.test.ts`.

agentToAccountId(address).notice: Reverse map: account id paying for a given agent (0 if         not registered). Selector-compatible.

coverPublishingCost(address,uint96,uint4.notice: Charge a publishing agent's allowance for `baseCost` and         distribute `discountedCost` over the published KA's         epoch range. Callable ONLY by `KnowledgeAssetsV10`.

createAccount(uint96,uint72).notice: Mint a new conviction-account NFT to the caller and         transfer `committedTRAC` into the V10 vault.

getAccountInfo(uint256).notice: Aggregate read combining account fields, top-up balance,         and agent count into one tuple. Selector-stable.

getDiscount(uint256).notice: Discount basis points fixed at creation for `accountId`.

getDiscountBps(uint96).notice: Discrete 6-tier discount ladder. Selector-compatible         wrapper read over the shared publishing math helper.

getDiscountedCost(uint256,uint96).notice: Discounted cost preview for a given account + base cost.

getRemainingAllowance(uint256,uint40).notice: Remaining base + topUp allowance for `accountId` in         chain `epoch`. Forwards to the logic contract's view.

isAgent(uint256,address).notice: Membership check used by off-chain integrations.

maxAgentsPerAccount().notice: Governance-tunable cap on registered agents per account.

publishingConvictionStorage().notice: V10 application-state store. Read directly for the         selector-stable public view forwarders below.

setMaxAgentsPerAccount(uint256).notice: Tune the per-account agent registration cap.

setPrimaryNode(uint256,uint72).notice: OT-RFC-51: re-designate the primary node that this account's         committed publishing allocation is credited to. Owner-gated         here; the logic contract enforces the once-per-epoch rate         limit and `nodeExists` validation for the new node, and moves         future-epoch allocation net-zero on K_total.

stakingStorageAddress().notice: V10 TRAC vault target. Resolves to         `ConvictionStakingStorage`, the post-v4.0.0         consolidation custodian. Field name retained for         storage layout stability across the legacy         `stakingStorageAddress` slot.

tokenContract().notice: TRAC ERC-20 reference; the publisher approves this         wrapper to pull TRAC into the vault on         `createAccount` / `topUp`.

userdoc.notice: Thin ERC-721 wrapper over publisher conviction accounts. V10 split-contract architecture (mirrors the staking-side `DKGStakingConvictionNFT` / `StakingV10` / `ConvictionStakingStorage` trio):   - This wrapper is a dumb ERC-721 ownership receipt: it mints/burns     tokens, validates ownership on mutating calls, drives the     publisher-facing TRAC `transferFrom`s, and forwards every     business action to `PublishingConviction`.   - All account / window / agent state lives on     `PublishingConvictionStorage`.   - All business logic (account creation, lazy passive-sink     settlement, post-expiry final sweep, active-sink epoch     distribution, agent management, transfer-hook agent clear)     lives on `PublishingConviction`. The logic address is resolved     lazily from Hub so it can be re-registered without touching this     wrapper. Wrapper-level state (intentional):   - `_nextAccountId`: monotonic mint counter, tightly coupled to     ERC-721 mint ordering. Mirrors `DKGStakingConvictionNFT.nextTokenId`.   - Hub-resolved contract refs (storage, token, vault) are loaded     once at `initialize()`; they are metadata, not application state. TRAC custody:   - The wrapper NEVER holds TRAC. `createAccount` / `topUp` move TRAC     directly from the publisher into the V10 vault     (`ConvictionStakingStorage`) via `transferFrom`. The publisher     therefore approves THIS wrapper as the spender (matching the     legacy v2.x UX so existing integrations keep working).   - `coverPublishingCost` does NOT physically move TRAC; it only     updates `EpochStorage` accounting. The escrowed TRAC is already     in the vault from `createAccount` / `topUp`. Public surface stability (selector-compatible with v2.x):   - The legacy `accounts(uint256)` auto-getter is preserved as an     explicit forwarder over the storage contract's auto-generated     `accounts` mapping getter — INCLUDING the legacy zero-tuple     return for an unknown `accountId` (it does NOT revert; use     `getAccount` for the fail-closed variant). See the function     NatSpec on `accounts(uint256)` below.   - `agentToAccountId(address)`, `topUpBalance(uint256)`,     `windowSpent(uint256, uint40)`, `maxAgentsPerAccount()` are kept     on the wrapper as forwarders so `IDKGPublishingConvictionNFT`,     `KnowledgeAssetsV10`, and `ContextGraphs` need no changes. Deliberate breaks in the v2.x → v3.0.0 wrapper bump:   - PCA state-change events (`AccountCreated`, `ToppedUp`,     `CostCovered`, `WindowSettled`, `AccountFinalSwept`,     `AgentRegistered`, `AgentDeregistered`) are emitted by     `PublishingConviction` (the logic contract), NOT by this     wrapper. Off-chain consumers that subscribe to PCA state     changes MUST listen to the `PublishingConviction` address     (resolved from Hub at `getContractAddress("PublishingConviction")`),     not this contract's address. This is the architectural     invariant of the V10 split: the logic contract owns business     semantics, including events. The 3.0.0 major version bump is     the deliberate signal of this break — do NOT add wrapper-side     re-emission to "preserve compatibility"; the canonical     listening address is the logic contract.   - The wrapper still emits ERC-721 events (`Transfer`,     `Approval`, `ApprovalForAll`) from its own address, exactly     as a normal NFT does — those are NOT moved.
